tools.name: moneygrid_fetch
tools.description: DEFAULT ($0.01/call). Fetch fresh content from one public HTTP/HTTPS URL and return up to 100k characters of machine-ready text with source metadata, timestamp and SHA-256 provenance. Use for web retrieval when you need current source content. Rejects private/local hosts, unsupported schemes, invali

tools.name: gridwatch_preflight
tools.description: $0.02 read-only endpoint preflight. Use before an agent depends on or pays an unfamiliar API, webhook or URL. Returns reachability, HTTP status, latency, risk flags and SHA-256 evidence. Rejects private/local hosts and malformed URLs; unreachable/upstream failures are returned explicitly rather than

tools.name: gridextract_markdown
tools.description: Paid read-only web extraction for agents. Fetches one public web URL and returns bounded clean text plus evidence hash and receipt metadata. Use when an agent needs compact machine-readable page content.

tools.name: gridverify_evidence
tools.description: Paid read-only URL evidence preflight ($0.05). Checks HTTP accessibility and operational risk flags, with response-sample hash and timestamp. Does not fact-check claims, establish source credibility, or verify factual truth.

tools.name: griddata_domain
tools.description: Paid read-only domain intelligence. Resolves current public DNS A-record data and returns timestamped hashed evidence. Use when an agent needs current domain/DNS evidence without maintaining its own resolver.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: moneygrid_fetch, gridwatch_preflight, gridextract_markdown, gridverify_evidence · Private data: moneygrid_fetch, gridwatch_preflight, griddata_domain · Public sink: gridwatch_preflight.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: moneygrid_fetch, gridwatch_preflight, gridextract_markdown, gridverify_evidence · Private data: moneygrid_fetch, gridwatch_preflight, griddata_domain · Public sink: gridwatch_preflight

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "gridwatch_preflight" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
